newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells 4.819 bln reais in Treasury papers.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells 4.819 bln reais in Treasury papers.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank, on behalf of the National Treasury, raised 4.819 billion reais during an auction Friday of two series of National Treasury Letters, known as LTNs, dealers said.
A total of 4.167 billon reais of 183-day LTNs, due December 15, 1997, was sold at an overnight call money rate of 2.282 percent a month.
The Central Bank also sold 652 million reais of 365-day LTNs, due June 15, 1998, at a call money rate of 2.445 percent a month.
